channel.title: Nanight Updates
channel.description: Stable releases of Nanight for macOS.

item.description: - Show or hide the camera from anywhere with a customizable global keyboard shortcut. The default is Control + Option + Command + N. - Clearer history filter buttons make it easier to see which activity types are shown. - History filter selections are now remembered across app restarts.

Reduces background compute and fixes memory growth during long sessions.
- Runs local baby-presence classification every 10 seconds instead of 3, reducing scheduled CLIP work and observation writes by 70%. Lightweight motion checks still run every 3 seconds and preserve activity between classifications. - Updates presence freshness, confirmation, and sleep-history timing for the slower cadence, while preserving the interpretation of older history. - Fixes completed temperature and humidity WebSocket connections accumulating in memory, with bounded timeouts and cleanup on success, failure, or cancellation. - Disables code-coverage instrumentation in distributable builds.
Developer ID signed and notarized by Apple. Validated with 107 app tests and 11 release-validation tests.

Fixes and improvements
- Fix dragging the pinned camera window. - Prevent recursive popover resizing when rotating the camera. - Click Motion, Sound, In bed, or Sleeping in the activity legend to show or hide that track.
